regression_risks: The submodule bump pairs core with a newer intelligence commit. If develop's addon pin is meant to move separately, merging this branch moves it implicitly.

MISSING_CASES does not include a before-setup run with a missing passwords.json while the other files exist. The existing test_minimal_run_writes_empty_passwords_json covers the plain fresh case.
